title: Pulsar Sipper Replacement Cup 2 Pack
description:
These glass cup attachments are an official part for the Pulsar Sipper Vaporizer. Made from quality borosilicate glass, the Sipper Cup can be used with the Sipper’s Auto-Fill function to draw vapor hands free; then it can be removed so customers can sip at will. This pack includes 2 sipper cups, so users can fill one up and pass it along for a steady stream of shared vapor.

Pulsar Sipper Bubbler Features:
4.75 inches tall
Cup attachment
Borosilicate glass
Official part for the Pulsar Sipper Vaporizer

What’s in the Box:
2x – Pulsar Sipper Replacement Cup
